descriptions.1: Establishes a full TCP connection to identify open ports.
descriptions.2: Sends SYN packets to find open ports without completing the handshake.
descriptions.3: Sends FIN packets; open ports ignore, closed respond with RST.
descriptions.4: Sends packets with FIN, URG, and PSH flags to elicit responses.
descriptions.5: Sends packets with no flags to identify open ports by lack of response.
descriptions.6: Sends UDP packets to check for open UDP ports.
descriptions.7: Identifies open ports and determines the service/version running.
descriptions.8: Uses a third-party host to infer port states without revealing IP.
descriptions.9: Sends ACK packets to determine if ports are filtered or unfiltered.
descriptions.10: Uses ARP requests to discover devices and open ports on a local network.
